posts.title: My Bloody Habit
posts.description: Stir the juice, syrup and bitters in a cocktail shaker until well incorporated. Add Cynar and gin, then some ice and shake vigorously for 10 seconds. Double strain (with a mesh) into a chilled coupe glass and garnish with the blood orange peel.
